module: Flowgraph node "Create Timer" (category once_instant). Creates a timer via the flowgraph timer module. Inputs: duration (default 5 s), ref (hidden; dtSim simulation time, dtReal real time, dtRaw raw time). Output: timerId, to be passed to Get Timer / Set Timer Property.

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the node's internal state.

postInit.desc: Defines the preset values of the ref pin (dtSim, dtReal, dtRaw).

workOnce.desc: Calls self.mgr.modules.timer:addTimer({duration, mode=ref}) and publishes the id on timerId.
